'''R5-S9''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] that worked for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], R5-S9 was inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] with [[R4-M1/Legends|R4-M1]] when [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] rushed in to play a message.<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref> Later, during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], R5-S9 was working at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] in the [[Power control room/Legends|power control room]] when [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse entered the room. R5-S9 was destroyed by [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]], one of Bane's [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]].

==Behind the scenes==
In subsequent episodes, other R5-series droids were seen with the same blue and white markings.
A toy of R5-S9 was released by [[Hasbro]] in 2017 as part of the ''Star Wars: Droid Factory'' set. However, the toy had a light blue dome, while in the animated series R5-S9's dome appeared to be white.
